name: Multi-resolution Surface Feature Encoding
definition: A strategy to increase feature density in regions requiring high-frequency detail by creating virtual vertices within mesh faces, controlled by a per-face Level of Detail (LOD) factor $k_i$, without modifying the actual mesh topology.
summary: Multi-resolution Surface Feature Encoding increases feature density by creating virtual vertices within mesh faces, controlled by per-face LOD factors, to capture high-frequency details without modifying actual mesh topology.
